payload.title: A concept page describes its concept as structured data
payload.description:
As a search or answer engine, I want a concept page to describe its concept as a defined term, so that the concept is understood without scraping prose. Only accepted descriptions and confirmed neighbours are published; the words an editor wrote on a link stay private.

```gherkin
Feature: Concept pages as defined terms
  Scenario: An accepted concept with a reviewed description
    Given an accepted concept with other names and two confirmed neighbours
    When its wiki page is projected
    Then the page's structured data names the concept, its other names and its description
    And each confirmed neighbour appears by identifier with its relation

  Scenario: A draft description is left out
    Given a concept whose description nobody accepted
    When its wiki page is projected
    Then the structured data has no description

  Scenario: A suggested link is not published
    Given a neighbour link that is only suggested
    Then the neighbour does not appear in the structured data
```
